      @GetMapping("/by-username") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<UserDTO> getByUsername(@RequestParam String username)
      Search by username: GET /api/v1/users/by-username?username=peter. A dedicated path (not a query param on the collection) so it is a distinct, unambiguous operation in the OpenAPI spec / clients.

    • update

      @PutMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<UserDTO> update(@PathVariable Long id, @RequestBody UserRequest request)
      PUT: full update of the editable profile fields. Password, roles, personal permissions and the department are preserved, not replaced — they are managed through dedicated, elevated-authorization endpoints and never travel through this request body.

    • partialUpdate

      @PatchMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<UserDTO> partialUpdate(@PathVariable Long id, @RequestBody UserRequest patch)
      PATCH: Partial update – only supplied fields are overwritten. Roles and the admin flag are not modifiable.
